source: NASA MODIS MOD10A1 v6.1 daily snow cover, 500 m (MODIS/061/MOD10A1), NDSI_Snow_Cover >= 40
note: Mean share of land above 2000 m that is snow covered: in March, and in April-May (how long the snow lasts). r is the Pearson correlation with the FLDAS March snow water volume, 2001-2026. Cover is not depth.
